author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Kicking off our first Homebrew Website Club here at @SCSU New Haven

While I have done a bunch of online HWC-Blogging 101 sessions this is the first time I am hosting a live HWC in New Haven

Excited as I start the day showing people how cool Loqi is

In the screenshot above you see me ask Loqi a question and the bot responds with the summary of a wiki article. Then you see someone else add++ after my name which awards me karma. I then ask Loqi to do some math and convert a time zone. Finally I show you how Loqi can describe different #IndieWeb members.
